verdict.rationale: BVNK exposes a conventional REST API (e.g. POST /payment/v1/rules, POST /payment/v2/payins/simulation) with Hawk auth. The platform itself generates unique blockchain addresses for payments and handles conversion and settlement. It also reports on-chain confirmations via webhooks, so developers interact with endpoints rather than chain infrastructure. However, the evidence never shows client libraries or SDKs in any language; the only tooling noted is a CLI. Node and gas abstraction is implied rather than stated. missing for 10: documented language client libraries/SDKs, explicit statement that gas fees and node operation are handled by the platform, independent or hands-on corroboration.
